headline: SDP @ MIL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SDP 2.58 at MIL 3.57, with a projected total of 6.15. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIL: SDP moved -1.09 runs while MIL moved -0.92, changing the projected margin by -0.18 runs. The projected total fell -2.01, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +10.5%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Jacob Misiorowski has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 1.2 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Brice Turang, William Contreras, Jake Bauers, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ramón Laureano, Manny Machado because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
